This guide addresses that gap by providing a clear, step-by-step process for deploying a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-11|cloudflare]] Pages, utilizing a robust infrastructure that accepts crypto payments without the need for traditional banking systems. By following this guide, you will gain the ability to launch your store quickly and efficiently, positioning yourself to thrive in the digital marketplace.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The challenges faced by digital creators in countries with financial restrictions often stem from reliance on centralized payment systems. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed for sovereignty, allowing you to maintain full control and ownership over your digital store without depending on external platforms. Utilizing technologies like Cloudflare Pages, which offers free hosting and unmatched performance, ensures that your store is not only accessible but also resilient against outages and restrictions. This approach prioritizes stability and independence, giving you the tools necessary to operate without the hurdles imposed by conventional payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into the deployment process, you should gather essential components for your digital store. This includes a Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions, and an understanding of the products you plan to sell. You will also need to prepare your digital assets, such as ebooks or courses, and have a basic knowledge of Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Having this foundational setup in place ensures a smoother deployment process, allowing you to launch your store efficiently and effectively.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a seamless payment and delivery system, start by integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages setup. This involves configuring your payment settings to accept multiple cryptocurrencies, ensuring transactions are processed swiftly with minimal fees. Next, set up your delivery mechanism using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your digital products. By automating the delivery process with Google Apps Script, you ensure that customers receive their purchases immediately upon confirmation of payment. This streamlined pipeline not only enhances customer experience but also establishes trust in your digital store.
No subscriptions or dependencies on third-party platforms - you're in control.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your Cloudflare Pages site and ensure all components are functioning as expected. Conduct thorough testing to confirm that the payment and delivery systems work flawlessly. Once verified, promote your store to your target audience. Processing your first transaction will validate your setup and provide a real-world test of your infrastructure. Monitor the transaction closely to address any issues that may arise and ensure a smooth customer experience from purchase to delivery.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store and processing initial transactions, focus on scaling. Use insights from customer interactions to refine your product offerings and marketing strategies. Consider expanding your product catalog and optimizing your payment options to attract a broader audience. You may also explore upgrading to Stack 02 for advanced features like database management with Supabase and enhanced delivery capabilities. Continuous monitoring and adjustment will ensure your store remains competitive and meets the evolving needs of your customers.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Instant payment processing with low fees enhances customer satisfaction.

Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by using Cloudflare Pages for hosting, integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and employing Google Apps Script for backend operations. This method ensures you avoid traditional payment platform fees and retain complete control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages with Apps Script for a simpler setup, taking 4-6 hours for deployment. Stack 02, however, utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, providing a more robust infrastructure deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store. They provide reliable, free hosting solutions with the capability to integrate payment processors like NOWPayments for crypto transactions.
What payment methods can I accept using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing a flexible payment solution for your digital store. This ensures you can cater to a wide audience without traditional banking restrictions.
How can I scale my digital store once it is live?

To scale your digital store, analyze customer data to refine your product offerings, consider expanding your catalog, and optimize payment methods. Exploring advanced features in Stack 02 can also provide additional tools for scaling your business.
